machine: HC-YX840 roof-panel roll-forming line built in China to IEC 60204-1 / GB standards, with no PLC. The forming rolls are driven continuously by the 5.5 kW main motor M1 on a Delta VFD-E inverter U1 (with braking resistor R1). A 1000 ppr measuring-wheel encoder B1 on the strip feeds the auxiliary encoder input (CN5) of a Delta ASDA-A2 servo drive U2, whose built-in E-CAM flying-shear function moves the 1.5 kW servo carriage M3 in sync with the strip and gives a cut signal; a hydraulic shear (pump M2 2.2 kW DOL, valve YV1 down / YV2 up, limits SQ1/SQ2) cuts on the fly. Sequencing is hard-wired relay logic (KA1-KA10, cut watchdog timer KT1, Omron H7CX batch counter), with run-out table and material sensors. Two E-stops and the shear guard switch are monitored by a Pilz PNOZ s3 safety relay. Supply 380 V 3-phase + N + PE 50 Hz, 220 VAC pump contactor control, 24 VDC relay control, servo drive on 220 V single phase (L3-N).
machineCn: HC-YX840 彩钢瓦冷弯成型机：主电机 5.5 kW 经变频器驱动成型辊连续成型；测长编码器测量板材长度，伺服驱动器电子凸轮(E-CAM)追剪功能使剪切小车与板材同步，液压剪刀在同步区剪断；计数器统计根数，批量完成后自动停机。无 PLC，继电器逻辑控制；急停、防护罩由安全继电器监控。

relayLogic.description: Hydraulic pump KM1 (220 VAC): 101 -> KA0 13-14 -> SB2 (NC stop) -> SB1 (NO start) in parallel with KM1 13-14 (self-hold) -> FR1 95-96 -> KM1 coil -> N51. Pump running lamp HL2 via KM1 63-64.
relayLogic.descriptionCn: 液压泵：SB1 启动，KM1 13-14 自锁，SB2 停止，FR1 95-96 过载保护，KA0 13-14 安全断开。

relayLogic.description: Line run KA1 (24VS): SB4 (NC stop) -> KM1 53-54 (pump running) -> KA5 11-14 (servo ready) -> KA6 11-12 (no servo alarm) -> U1 RB-RC (VFD healthy) -> KT1 15-16 (cut watchdog not timed out) -> H7CX OUT NC (batch not complete) -> KA9 11-12 (no run-out overrun) -> KA10 11-14 (material present) -> SB3 (NO start) in parallel with KA1 11-14 (self-hold) -> KA1 coil; HL3 in parallel with the coil. KA1 21-24 runs the VFD forward (MI1) and KA1 31-34 engages the servo E-CAM (DI7).
relayLogic.descriptionCn: 联动运行：SB4 停止、油泵运行、伺服准备好、无伺服报警、变频器正常、剪切未超时、批量未完成、出料未超长、有料，按 SB3 启动 KA1 自锁；HL3 运行指示。

relayLogic.description: Jog (24VS, only while KA1 is off via KA1 41-42): SB5 -> KA3 11-12 -> KA2 coil (jog forward: MI1 + MI3); SB6 -> KA2 11-12 -> KA3 coil (jog reverse: MI2 + MI3); KA2/KA3 are mutually interlocked.
relayLogic.descriptionCn: 点动：仅在 KA1 未运行时 (KA1 41-42)，SB5 点动正转 KA2，SB6 点动反转 KA3，互锁。

relayLogic.description: Servo enable: 24VS -> SA1 -> KA4 coil; KA4 11-14 switches U2 DI1 (SON).
relayLogic.descriptionCn: 伺服使能：SA1 闭合 -> KA4 -> U2 DI1 SON。

relayLogic.description: Sensors: SQ3 (run-out end photo, NPN) switches KA9 coil (overrun stops the line); SQ4 (entry inductive, NPN) switches KA10 coil (material present permits run).
relayLogic.descriptionCn: 出料末端光电 SQ3 -> KA9 (停机)；进料接近开关 SQ4 -> KA10 (有料)。

relayLogic.description: Servo outputs (24VS through relay coils to U2 DO+ / DO- to 0V): DO1 SRDY -> KA5, DO5 ALRM -> KA6, DO3 cut command -> KA7. U2 inputs from 24V2 COM+: DI1 SON (KA4), DI5 ARST (SB9 23-24), DI7 CAM (KA1 31-34).
relayLogic.descriptionCn: 伺服输出：DO1 SRDY -> KA5，DO5 ALRM -> KA6，DO3 剪切信号 -> KA7。

relayLogic.description: Shear down: 24VS -> KA7 11-14 (servo cut) or wire 341 (SB7 manual cut, only with KA1 off) -> KA8 11-12 -> YV1; watchdog KT1 in parallel with YV1: if the shear stays down-commanded for 2 s, KT1 15-16 opens the line run circuit.
relayLogic.descriptionCn: 剪刀下行：KA7 或手动剪切 SB7 (仅停机) -> KA8 常闭 -> YV1；KT1 与 YV1 并联，2 s 未到下限则 KT1 15-16 断开联动。

relayLogic.description: Shear return: SQ1 (down limit) energises KA8, which holds through KA8 21-24 and SQ2 (up limit NC); KA8 31-34 energises YV2 (shear up) and KA8 11-12 drops YV1; at the top SQ2 opens and KA8 drops out. KA8 41-44 pulses the H7CX count input CP1.
relayLogic.descriptionCn: 剪刀回程：SQ1 下限 -> KA8，经 SQ2 上限常闭自锁；KA8 -> YV2 上行，到上限 SQ2 断开复位；KA8 41-44 计数。

relayLogic.description: Batch counter H7CX (24V1): CP1 counts cuts from KA8 41-44, SB8 resets (RST); at preset the OUT changeover opens the KA1 run circuit (OUT NC) and lights HL5 (OUT NO).
relayLogic.descriptionCn: 批量计数：H7CX 计数剪切次数，到预置值 OUT 动作，停机并点亮 HL5；SB8 复位。

relayLogic.description: Pilot lights (24V1): HL1 power on, HL2 pump running (KM1 63-64), HL4 fault (KA6 21-24 or U1 RA-RC), HL5 batch complete (H7CX OUT NO); HL3 line running is on sheet 5.
relayLogic.descriptionCn: 指示灯：HL1 电源，HL2 油泵运行，HL4 故障 (KA6 或 U1 RA-RC)，HL5 批量完成。

relayLogic.description: VFD control (U1 sink inputs, common DCM): MI1 forward via KA1 21-24 or KA2 21-24; MI2 reverse via KA3 21-24; MI3 JOG via KA2 31-34 or KA3 31-34.
relayLogic.descriptionCn: 变频器控制：DCM 公共端，KA1/KA2 -> MI1 正转，KA3 -> MI2 反转，KA2/KA3 -> MI3 点动。

safety.logic: SB0 and SB10 (2NC each) in series, two channels S11-S12 / S21-S22 of PNOZ s3 KA0; KA0 13-14 opens the 220 VAC coil circuit of KM1 (hydraulic pump); KA0 23-24 removes 24VS from all relays KA1-KA10, KT1 and valves YV1/YV2 (line run, jog, servo ON, cut)
SQ5 2NC in series with the E-stops in both channels of KA0; same outputs as the E-stop

safety.function: Manual monitored reset with external device monitoring
safety.cn: 手动复位 + 接触器反馈监控
safety.logic: S33-S34 loop: KM1 21-22 (NC feedback) in series with SB9 13-14

interlocks: The line (KA1) can only start when the hydraulic pump is running (KM1 53-54), the servo is ready (KA5) and not in alarm (KA6), the VFD is healthy (U1 RB-RC), the cut watchdog has not timed out (KT1), the batch is not complete (H7CX), there is no run-out overrun (KA9) and material is present (KA10).
Jog forward/reverse (KA2/KA3) and the manual cut (SB7) are only possible while the line run relay KA1 is off (KA1 41-42).
Jog forward and jog reverse are mutually interlocked (KA3 11-12 in KA2, KA2 11-12 in KA3).
The shear-down solenoid YV1 is dropped by KA8 11-12 as soon as the down limit SQ1 is reached, so YV1 and YV2 can never be energised together.
If the shear is commanded down for more than 2 s without reaching SQ1, timer KT1 15-16 opens the line run circuit.
At the batch preset the H7CX output stops the line (OUT NC) until the counter is reset with SB8.
The hydraulic pump contactor KM1 coil is supplied through safety relay KA0 13-14 and overload FR1 95-96; all 24 V relays, the timer and the shear valves are fed from 24VS through KA0 23-24.
The safety relay KA0 can only be reset with SB9 when KM1 is dropped out (KM1 21-22 feedback in S33-S34).
The servo flying-shear cam (DI7) is engaged only while the line runs (KA1 31-34); the servo is enabled only with SA1 on and the safety circuit closed (KA4 on 24VS).
